notes.title: Minor Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Minor Update v1.3.0 is now live.

Crosshair Preview
The crosshair editor now contains a crosshair preview with the ability to toggle on and off the animations.  This should make editing the crosshair more convenient when it is hidden.

Visibility Indicator
There is now a visibility indicator for the crosshair in the top left corner of the application.  It will be green if the crosshair is currently visible and red if it is not.  Clicking the indicator while toggle it's visibility.

Scrollable Sliders
Any slider inputs should now accept scrolling as a method of changing their value.  This will make it easier to make small adjustments to slides that accept a large range.

Stability Changes
I have made changes behind the scenes that should help prevent any issues from appearing.  If you do happen to notice any please reach out to me via the Discord.

notes.title: Small Patch v1.2.1
notes.content:
Remove unintentional ability to highlight different things in the app
 Remove ability to drag and drop certain parts of the app onto the desktop
 Fix issue with the end position of odd thickness crosshairs

notes.title: Major Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Major Update v1.2.0 is now live.

New Crosshair Renderer
I have remade the entire crosshair renderer to allow for dynamic crosshairs.  Any pre-existing crosshairs will continue to use the old renderer but won't be able to take advantage of this new feature.

Updated UI
I updated the UI to because I felt like it wasn't visually appealing. The positioning of everything has remained the same so don't worry about having to relearn how to do anything.

Crosshair Level Positioning
There is now an option for setting the position of an entire crosshair.  This means if you want a specific crosshair to be offset by some amount you can change all layers at once. This is good for crosshairs made for specific games where you don't necessarily want the crosshair dead center.

Stability Changes
I have made changes behind the scenes to help improve the stability of the app.  If you notice anything weird or have issues, please contact me on Discord.

notes.title: Dynamic Crosshair Update
notes.content:
In the coming week I will am going to be pushing an update for adding dynamic crosshairs, a new UI theme, and crosshair level position settings.  I plan to have it out before March 13th.  The next thing I plan on adding is Xbox Game Bar support.  This will allow for program to support all games that Xbox Game Bar works for.  If anyone has any feedback or suggestions feel free to join the discord.

- Capy

notes.title: Minor Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Minor Update v1.1.0 is now live.

Light Theme
There are now light and dark themes available.  By default, the application will be set to the system default but can be changed in the settings page or the theme icon next to the minimize buttons.

Crosshairs Page
The crosshairs page has been updated to allow for favoriting crosshairs.  This will cause the favorited crosshairs to display first in the list.  Each list item has also had graphical changes to make it easier to distinguish which crosshair is active and being selected.

Stability Changes
There have also been some changes behind the scenes to help improve the stability of the application.  These changes shouldn't affect how you interact with the application but help prevent instances where issues might occur.  A button has also been added to the settings page to open the logs folder.  This should make reporting bugs easier if the log files are needed.

https://discord.gg/aAHdkavDC5
